camera.coordinateOrder: latitude, longitude; WGS84; y is scene metres, not ground clearance or surveyed elevation

fixture.status: Simulated calibration fixture, not live weather or observed phenology
fixture.source: style-b-calibration-v2/sharedLook; foliage-seasons-v1/species.seasonColours; lake-winter-v1/water.windStates and skyStates. Wind direction is a shared simulated input, not a camera fit.; haze-visibility-v1 regions[].seasons.summer.clear. Homogeneous authored clear fallback, no local layer or summit-obscuring cloud supplied; not an observation. Date is an explicit deterministic replay input; foliage follows regional calendar art prior at R request, not observed phenology. Summer-clear atmosphere remains the separately requested test fixture.

airlight.mix: Decode day and time hex; mix in linear light using timeMix. Prefer physically lit directional sky/horizon radiance when supported. These are authored palette fallbacks, not spectral scattering data.
airlight.distanceTint: Distance changes T only; no additional distance desaturation or second fog grade. At tau .1 mix9.52%, tau .5 mix39.35%, tau1 mix63.21%, tau3 mix95.02%. Silhouettes approach actual directional airlight, not saturated blue or white. Night lighting changes airlight, not sigma just because it is dark.
airlight.preserveCalibration: Exposure, matte materials, saturation and warm direct sunlight remain calibration-v2. No local lamps added to global airlight.

integration.sharedWorldTerm: Same view-ray optical depth for land, water, buildings, trees and terrain. Atmosphere-rendered sky/reflections must not receive duplicate atmospheric passes.
integration.localFog: Preserve night-fog/marine-fog layer bounds, patch masks and densitites. Base sigma from this pack; add local sigma only for physically traversed local layer. If observation already represents that local layer, fit layer plus background to total rather than adding observation and layer twice.
integration.layerColour: Single final homogeneous mix only if airlight is common; otherwise integrate each segment front to back with its airlight. Optical-depth-weighted colour alone is not exact for layered media.
integration.regionalSeasonRanges: All ranges describe scenario authoring envelopes, not percentiles, observations or prevalence. Uniform event defaults are deliberate conditional fallbacks. Use local data for mountain-valley inversions, SF marine fog, wildfire layers, tropical wet/dry seasons and location variation.
